Evaluation : update_acl

Evaluation_UpdateAcl.Rd

Update the access control list (ACL) for this evaluation.

You can either:
1. Provide a principal_id and access_type list to update permissions for a specific user/team
2. Provide a complete ACL named list to update all permissions at once

To remove a principal from the ACL completely, provide an empty list for access_type.

The available access types are:

- "CREATE"
- "SUBMIT"
- "READ_PRIVATE_SUBMISSION"
- "DELETE_SUBMISSION"
- "UPDATE_SUBMISSION"
- "CHANGE_PERMISSIONS"
- "READ"
- "DELETE"
- "UPDATE"

Usage

synUpdateAcl(instance, principal_id=NULL, access_type=NULL, acl=NULL, synapse_client=NULL)

Arguments

instance

(Evaluation) The Evaluation instance to operate on.

principal_id

(Optional[Union[str, int]]) The Synapse user or team ID to update permissions for.

access_type

(Optional[list[str]]) List of permission strings to grant to the principal. If empty, the principal will be removed from the ACL.

acl

(Optional[named list]) A named list containing the complete ACL data to update. You can retrieve the current ACL using synGetAcl(). If provided, principal_id and access_type are ignored.

synapse_client

(Optional[Synapse]) If not passed in, the last created instance from the Synapse class constructor will be used.

Value

The updated AccessControlList response object as a named list.

Errors

- An error is raised if neither (principal_id and access_type) nor acl is provided, or if the ACL object is invalid.
- An error is also raised if the service rejects the request or an HTTP error occurs.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Example 1: Update permissions for a specific principal (user/team)
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    PROJECT_ID = "syn123456"  # replace with your project ID

    # Store a new evaluation in the project first
    evaluation = Evaluation(
        name = "My Challenge Evaluation",
        description = "Evaluation for my data challenge",
        content_source = PROJECT_ID,
        submission_instructions_message = "Submit CSV files only",
        submission_receipt_message = "Thank you for your submission!"
    ) |> synStore()

    # Update permissions for user with ID 12345
    updated_acl = evaluation |> synUpdateAcl(
        principal_id = "12345",
        access_type = list("READ", "SUBMIT")
    )
    updated_acl

## Example 2: Remove a principal (user/team) from the ACL
    # Using the evaluation stored in Example 1

    # Remove user with ID 12345 from the ACL by providing an empty list
    updated_acl = evaluation |> synUpdateAcl(
        principal_id = "12345",
        access_type = list()
    )
    updated_acl

## Example 3: Update the entire ACL manually
    # Using the evaluation stored in Example 1

    # Get the current ACL
    acl = evaluation |> synGetAcl()

    # Modify the ACL manually
    acl$resourceAccess = c(acl$resourceAccess, list(list(
        principalId = 12345L,
        accessType = list("READ", "SUBMIT")
    )))

    # Update with the modified ACL
    updated_acl = evaluation |> synUpdateAcl(acl = acl)
    updated_acl
} # }
